contract.reference: Independent CPU float64 formulas evaluated on actual CPU-quantized input values.
contract.input_generation: CPU seeded FP32 normal *0.5, then genuine requested storage dtype; no device-side harness casts.
contract.fp8_policy: Genuine requested FP8 input/output storage; arithmetic as upstream source specifies. FP32 norm/rotation is not FP8 TensorCore compute.
contract.tolerance_policy: FP8 reference is unquantized FP64 mathematics; acceptance includes nearest-rounding half-relative-ULP bound plus half-subnormal step (E4M3:6.25%,2^-10; E5M2:12.5%,2^-17), with small FP32 margin. Not a relaxed FP16 substitute.
contract.source_policy: Exact original kernel function AST, isolated imports; fixed num_warps launch replaces only FLA autotuner selection. No mathematical edits.
contract.cache_contract: [3,B,S,D] FP32 raw T/H/W caches, distinct axis positions, duplicated halves. All multi-axis selection is executed inside the timed upstream kernel.
contract.forbidden_shortcut: No preselected GPU caches or ordinary RoPE substitution.
contract.formula: NeoX half split: q/k_out = concat(x_left*cos-x_right*sin, x_right*cos+x_left*sin)
contract.arithmetic: Q/K loaded from genuine requested storage then converted by upstream kernel to FP32 cache dtype; FP32 rotation, final store in requested dtype.
contract.timed_scope: Two exact Triton copy kernels + one exact in-place rotation kernel; refresh is inside every timed call.
contract.byte_policy: Useful Q/K read+write plus one selected cos/sin half per token; additional Q/K copy read+write. Unselected/duplicated cache coordinates are not counted as loaded bytes.
contract.input_immutability: Q/K source tensors are never mutated; outputs reset by included copies each invocation.
